title: Surgical Pavilion: ORs Ready for Trauma — Elective Cancellations Needed

transcript.speaker: Priya Nair
transcript.text: AOC, Priya Nair in the Surgical Pavilion. OR 1 and OR 2 are closing. We have three trauma laparotomies in progress, and OR 3, 4, and 5 are prepped and sterile. I have four OR teams on site, but sterile processing is behind on trauma instrument sets. The hybrid rooms 11 and 12 are ready, but we have no PACS access for prior imaging, and we can't pull up pre-op studies. I need to know — do I cancel the evening elective list and recall off-duty staff for trauma?

transcript.speaker: Helen Marchetti
transcript.text: Understood, Priya. Cancel all elective cases for tonight. Recall all off-duty OR staff. Open ORs 3 to 5 for trauma. I’ll confirm imaging support in 30 minutes. Move priority instruments to trauma sets now.

transcript.speaker: Priya Nair
transcript.text: Copy, AOC. I’m sending a runner to coordinate sterile processing. We’ll start with OR 3 and 4.

instructorNote: This inject confirms the AOC’s decision to activate surge capacity. Watch for the CNO to assign sterile processing staff to trauma instrument sets and for the EDMD to confirm imaging support timelines.
